KeyWord.milk_frogDescription: After this card resolves, each other Milk Frog still in your draw or discard pile resolves once more — at most this keyword's number of them, and they do not trigger further Milk Frogs.
KeyWord.manual_bulwarkDescription: After this card resolves, gain 3 additional Block.

EffectDescription.Key_mf_grave_swell: Deal damage equal to {Number}x the size of your discard pile.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_bellow: Gain {Number} temporary Power; when resolved by Milk Frog, gain {Number1} Power.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_bleed_if_cascade: When resolved by Milk Frog: apply {Number} Bleed to the target.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_glare_cascade: When resolved by Milk Frog: apply {Number} Vulnerable to all enemies.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_swarm_surge_cascade: When resolved by Milk Frog: deal {Number} damage to all enemies.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_choose_discard: Put {Number} card(s) from your hand into the discard pile.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_choir_tenacity: This turn, each time a Milk Frog card resolves, gain {Number} additional Tough.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_summon_family_random: Summon a random Milk Family member.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_summon_family_all: Summon one of each Milk Family member.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_resolve_random_until_death: Repeatedly resolve a random summon until it dies.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_milk_clock: If you have Milk Egg?: apply 1d8 layers of every debuff and deal 1d8 damage to all enemies. Otherwise summon Milk Egg?.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_milk_clock_up: If you have Milk Egg?: apply 3d4 layers of every debuff and deal 3d4 damage to all enemies. Otherwise summon Milk Egg?.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_essence_question: Lose 8 max life until the end of combat, then summon Milk Egg?.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_all_summons: Resolve every summon's effect until all of them die.
EffectDescription.Key_mf_settle_all: Resolve every Milk Frog card in your draw pile.

AbilityDescription.naifrog.milkfrog_choice: When Milk Frog pulls, you choose which Milk Frog cards resolve.
AbilityDescription.naifrog.milkfrog_choice_full: When Milk Frog pulls, you choose any cards to resolve.
AbilityDescription.naifrog.mf_dynasty_aura: Newly summoned Milk Family members get +3 to every number (including repeat counts).

Relic.naifrog.milk_frog_talisman_Des: When you trigger Milk Frog, draw 1 card. Twice per turn at most.
